maddeler.e:
أنحسر (form VII)
# أَنْحَسِرُ (ʔanḥasiru) /ʔan.ħa.si.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
# أَنْحَسِرَ (ʔanḥasira) /ʔan.ħa.si.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
# أَنْحَسِرْ (ʔanḥasir) /ʔan.ħa.sir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
